name: cerebral cavernous malformation (CCM)
species: human; also used for animal-model lesions in b0099
merge_basis: Abbreviation defined in b0011 'Cerebral cavernous malformation (CCM)'. CMM (b0099) is read as a typo for CCM because the preceding sentence of the same paragraph says 'few therapeutic strategies for CCM'.
ambiguity: 'CCM' also prefixes gene-group terms (CCM genes, CCM complexes, CCM genotype) and lesion counts (CCM lesions); those are flagged as modifier mentions. Umbrella term covering sporadic and familial CCM.

name: familial cerebral cavernous malformation (FCCM)
surface_forms: ["FCCM", "Familial CCM", "Familial cerebral cavernous malformation", "familial CCM", "familial cerebral cavernous malformation"]
merge_basis: Abbreviation defined in b0003 and b0011 ('Familial CCM (FCCM)').
ambiguity: Includes 'clinical FCCM' (no mutation detected) and 'gene-confirmed FCCM'; the paper treats both as FCCM. 'FCCM gene' is a gene-panel modifier.

name: sporadic cerebral cavernous malformation
merge_basis: b0011 divides CCM into 'sporadic and familial categories'; 'sporadic CCM' and the elliptical 'sporadic and familial CCM' refer to the same subtype.
